name: Split
description: An image beside a block of text — eyebrow, heading, a markdown body and buttons — on either side, stacked on phones. The media-and-text section of a landing page (Gutenberg media-text, a two-column Elementor container with an image, Divi's image + text row).

imageSide.description: Which side the image takes on wide screens: start (left in left-to-right text) or end. Phones always show it after the text.

body.label: Text
body.description: The text beside the image, as markdown: paragraphs, emphasis, links, lists.

actions.label: Buttons

href.label: Link
href.description: Where the button goes: a page on this site or a full address.

newTab.label: Open in a new tab
newTab.description: Open the link in a new tab (an external site the reader should not leave for).

style.label: Style
style.description: primary for the main action, secondary or ghost for the ones beside it.

actions.description: Buttons under the text, in order (Elementor button, Gutenberg buttons, Divi button).

image.label: Image

alt.label: Image description
alt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it; empty when it is decoration.

image.description: The image beside the text. Width and height, when known, let the site reserve its space.

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

a11y: The section is labelled by its heading. The image is a separate figure in reading order after the text; an empty description marks a decorative one.
